training_source: ECML-PKDD 2007 generated requests, original train/test repartitioned
external_source: CSIC 2010 normal/anomalous test requests; evaluation only
selection: validation recall under one-sided 95% FPR upper bound <= 1%, then AP; calibration threshold separate
test_policy: one evaluation after configuration freeze; no tuning on ECML holdout or CSIC
limitations: Historical generated traffic, not production representative.
No kernel outcomes or privacy leakage labels.
Binomial bound assumes IID/exchangeability; template-group intervals also reported.
